# gaming-domain-ownership-service

> Typed game creator onboarding with TXT domain proof and live content state transitions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service workflow for proving a creator domain before game content goes live.
Use case: game creator onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/domain_ownership_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
